title: youngia longipes
intro: Youngia longipes, commonly known as the Chinese artichoke, is a type of plant that belongs to the daisy family. The plant is valued for its edible tubers, which are rich in inulin and have been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat a variety of ailments. The health benefits of Youngia longipes include its ability to promote digestion, lower blood sugar levels, and improve immune function, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Youngia longipes include inulin, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
